summary: Application with tiered pricing plans, model management, chart visualization, and export functionality

existing_features.title: Update ProfileSetupModal to display and allow selection between Free Tier ($0/year - 3 models/year) and Premium Tier ($235/year - 300 models/year) during initial profile creation
Update SubscriptionModal to display Free Tier option and allow upgrades from Free to Premium
Limit Free Tier users to 2 export operations (CSV and PDF combined) with a counter displayed in the UI
Add individual export buttons to each chart component (CostBreakdownPieChart, CumulativeCashFlowChart, ProductionBarChart) that allow users to download the chart as an image file
Update DashboardHeader subscription usage display to show model usage and export usage separately for Free tier users

new_feature_requests.summary: Limit free plan users to 2 free exports
Add export button for chart images
Add a Free Tier subscription plan at $0/year with a limit of 3 models per year

projectName: Add Free Tier plan and chart export functionality
